_comment: Run template for lbnl-fpu: zone-terminal rules on the South-zone box of each fan-powered VAV scenario (equipment PFPU__<scenario> / SFPU__<scenario>). reheat_minimization_g36 is not run: VAV_PM_CFM_SP_S is the active airflow setpoint, not the design maximum the rule needs (it cannot fire on the fault-free run), and G36's dual-maximum reheat logic applies to single-duct boxes, not fan-powered ones.
